title: Cloud Security: capacity amendment
content:
Cloud Security capacity amendment is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The contract status is active or suspended.

The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized.

The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes.

The request external reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective interval start time.

Request and review events preserve those effective attributes.

Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records.

Refuse any change above maximum provisioned resource count or when completed amendment count has reached monthly accepted amendment limit.

Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding.

Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

The completed amendment count uses the UTC calendar month containing the frozen handling time.

Count completed amendment requests for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable amend action, authoritative system records must establish: The contract status is active or suspended. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference.

### Authoritative eligibility 2

Before the applicable amend action, authoritative system records must establish: The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference, customer request reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Does an amendment automatically replace a commitment?**

Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Historical interval

Hypothetical case: an approved amendment takes effect after an already recorded service interval. That earlier interval retains its old tier and effective price.
